field_evidence.document_currency: Ashford Borough Council document is marked Updated April 2026.
field_evidence.planning_records_scope: The council states planning permissions/decisions and pending applications are publicly available from 1974 to date on its website.
field_evidence.interactive_map_scope: The document states 1974-present planning information is available through the Interactive Map and 1984-present through the Online search tool.
field_evidence.public_access: The planning application/search and interactive-map information is described as publicly available/free of charge.
field_evidence.conservation_map_scope: The same document states conservation-area information is publicly available through the planning interactive map / Ashford WebMaps.
field_evidence.transport_result: The official Dynamic Maps public endpoint could not be retrieved by the available web transport, so no target-specific Forge Cottage map feature or geometry payload was obtained.
field_evidence.parcel_semantics_limit: Even a planning-application/map feature is not by itself an authoritative registered-title/cadastral parcel polygon. No planning-map geometry is promoted to canonical parcel geometry.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted without an authoritative target-specific parcel/title binding; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
